adapter_contract.population: the 32 known plane conics C1s in Stoll's exact perfect-cuboid model
adapter_contract.direct_support: the exact singular-point incidence set Cpts for the curve, transported to canonical node labels
adapter_contract.picard_support: the set of canonical node labels k for which the curve has positive intersection with the exceptional divisor over node k
adapter_contract.calibration_pass_condition: 32/32 exact equality direct_support == picard_support after canonical relabelling
adapter_contract.mass_firewall: total exceptional mass or any aggregate node-mass certificate is never accepted as a substitute for labelled 48-bit support

canonical_node_labelling.requirement: independent of Magma set iteration order
method: read each singular point in exact homogeneous coordinates over the exact source field
choose the first nonzero homogeneous coordinate and normalize it to 1
expand every normalized coordinate in one fixed exact Q-basis of the source number field recorded by the runtime adapter
encode the normalized coefficient tuples without floating point or printed-string comparison
sort the 48 exact keys lexicographically and label them N00..N47
assert all 48 keys are distinct and that relabelling is permutation invariant
forbidden_shortcuts: Sprint/pretty-printed field elements as the authority key unless separately proved canonical

span_contract.field: same exact field as the Stoll model
span_contract.projective_span_dimension: rank of the matrix of exact homogeneous node-coordinate rows minus 1
span_contract.genus0_nonconic_necessary_predicate: support_count >= 7 AND full supported-node coordinate rank == 7
span_contract.genus1_safe_consequence_predicate: after separately ruling out the hyperplane-section-component alternative, require existence of six supported nodes whose exact coordinate rank is 6
span_contract.genus1_do_not_use: do not require the full support to have rank exactly 6; that would strengthen Theorem 1.2 without justification

runtime_assertions_required: the exact singular locus contains 48 nodes
all canonical node keys are exact and pairwise distinct
the exceptional divisor list is bijectively matched to the same 48 nodes
32/32 C1s direct-support and Picard-support bitsets agree
all support ranks are computed over the exact source field
permutation of the source pts iteration order leaves canonical bitsets and ranks unchanged

next_if_runtime_calibration_passes.action: reconstruct labelled node support for each FULL178 residual row at the pre-aggregation integration point and apply only theorem-sound necessary predicates
